text.p: Jacobson Stores Inc said Friday that its president, James Fowler, has resigned.
P. Gerald Mills, chairman and chief executive officer, will immediately assume the duties of president.
The company said Fowler, 49, has not yet announced his plans. He had been president since 1993.

"We are fortunate to have the merchandising and operational talent in place at Jacobson's to streamline our decision-making process and unify our direction moving foward," Mills said in a statement. "Throughout the retail industry, senior management structures are being tightened, enabling swifter responses to a changing marketplace."
Jacobson Stores has 28 specialty department stores in Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky, Kansas and Florida.
